summary.overview: demucs-stem-server is a local Python FastAPI service that accepts uploaded audio files and separates them into individual stems using the Demucs ML models. The system is intentionally self-contained: it runs as one container, serves HTTP endpoints, loads models into memory, and returns ZIP archives or single-stem audio files without relying on a separate data store.
findings: The API exposes unauthenticated HTTP endpoints for health checks, model listing, full-stem export, and single-stem streaming (`server.py:200-327`), so anyone with network access to the service can invoke the separation pipeline.
The server keeps Demucs models in memory across requests (`server.py:42-77`), which reduces latency but also makes startup and memory cost proportional to the loaded model size.
The container is built as a single service (`Dockerfile:1-17`) and does not define any persistence layer or downstream data store, which matches the repository's local-processing design.
recommendations: Place the service behind an authenticated reverse proxy or firewall when it is exposed beyond a private local network, because the upload endpoints are public by default (`server.py:200-327`).
Consider explicit GPU or memory sizing in deployment if model caching is expected to handle concurrent users, since the service preloads and keeps models in memory (`server.py:42-77`).
